request.externalModelScope: Explicit development router tasks; no private originals or secrets

receiptLocalFusion.limits: Writer and runtime RLS views cannot reuse each other's proof solely because backend TX matches

decisions.whyThisMeasurement: Disjoint outer timings do not identify which repeated native validation/materialization actually dominates. Function-level actual time is needed before selecting a sufficient kernel change.

existingOldProfileGuard.reason: Older version would remove current closed first-failure diagnostics

futureScope.trackFunctions: all in exactly four write sessions, unchanged default none elsewhere
futureScope.pgStatClearSnapshotMeaning: Statistics-read snapshot only, never a database/file-cache purge or actual counter reset
futureScope.originalCompilerSQL: byte-identical stdin; tracking SET precedes and force-next-stats-flush DO follows it in same actual psql child
futureScope.timeInterpretation: Instrumented component only, nested total times must not be added; self and total times reported separately; no inferred Unit60 saving
futureScope.jitInterpretation: No claim that function stats alone prove JIT was triggered or identify JIT generation time
futureScope.originals: Existing authentic V12 POSTRUN and all originals stay unchanged; exactly one fresh isolated diagnostic working copy
futureScope.freshAuthority: New case/time/source/runtime/kernel/mount/process/one-time bindings required; all historical GOs/claims consumed
futureScope.resources: Unchanged existing native budget and CPU/heap/kernel contracts; all lifecycle and actual close/EOF checks required
futureScope.onFailure: Stop on FAIL/UNKNOWN/missing data, preserve all first-error evidence and working data, no automatic replay/retry
futureScope.success: Only a fully closed independently reviewed diagnostic profile with all original safeguards intact; no Auth30/Unit60/500MB/500er acceptance
futureScope.nativeOIDBinding: Actual new database OIDs and all qualified source bodies must be established by genuine qualifiers during the separately authorized measured setup, before the four writes; no invented or historical OIDs.
futureScope.commitBinding: Exactly the final committed clean HEAD named in the concrete GO; all reviewed source pins must match.

developmentRouterFees: UNKNOWN, not zero; distinct from unchanged operator Production cost contract

independentSourceReview.fixedBeforeExecution: Closed publication prefix retained; consistent filename and actual-publisher in-memory regression tests.

approvalTemplate: Authorize exactly one measured local setup and exactly one same-root-usage four-write function profile with --profile-functions, bound to this plan and the final clean commit named in GO, only after all fresh start gates. No Entry/Unit/motor/provider/full500, deletion or retry.
